title: The galaxy takes shape
summary: A swirling mass of gas and dust, roughly a hundred thousand light-years wide, collapses under its own gravity. Over ages it flattens into a spinning disk of stars wheeling around an enormous black hole at its heart.

title: Zhell drive the Taungs off Coruscant
summary: Early humans of the Zhell nations and the warrior Taungs fight for centuries over the world later named Coruscant. Even after a volcanic disaster cripples the Zhell, they finally expel the Taungs, who settle Roon: forebears of the Mandalorians.

title: Celestials build Centerpoint and imprison Abeloth
summary: Using Killik labor, the Celestials raise Centerpoint Station, a colossal tractor-beam engine able to drag planets into place, and assemble the Corellian system with it. They also bend the Maw's black holes into a prison for the dark being Abeloth.

title: Tho Yor bring Force pilgrims to Tython
summary: Eight pyramid-shaped Tho Yor ships wake across the galaxy, collect Force-sensitive beings of many species and carry them to Tython, a Deep Core world. The settlers found the Je'daii Order, which seeks balance between the light Ashla and the dark Bogan.
sources: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1
Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0

title: Rakata spread the Infinite Empire
summary: From Lehon, the Rakata wield dark-side technology, Force-driven hyperdrives and the Star Forge among it, to conquer and enslave hundreds of worlds. At its height around 30,000 BBY their empire spans much of the galaxy, remaking planets such as Kashyyyk and Tatooine.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
conflict: The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia dates the empire's rise to c. 35,000 BBY, but Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4 shows it already long established well before 36,453 BBY.

title: King Adas unites the Sith and repels Rakata
summary: The axe-wielding sorcerer-king Adas welds Korriban's warring Sith nations into one realm and reigns for about three centuries. When Rakatan invaders land he drives them off and seizes their ships, but dies doing it; Korriban becomes a tomb world and the Sith rule from Ziost.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side

title: Coruscant's sleeper ships seed human colonies
summary: Humans native to Coruscant begin sending out slow sublight sleeper ships, a program that runs for some fifteen centuries. Their colonists settle Kuat, Alderaan, Metellos, the Tion Cluster and more, while the Kuat Explorer carries settlers to Alsakan.

title: Despot War breaks Queen Hadiya's invasion
summary: Hadiya, a Twi'lek crime queen, bullies and charms Shikaakwa's barons into line, then invades the Tython system. The Je'daii rally against her army, and Ranger Daegen Lok, planted in her camp as a spy, kills her; the invasion falls apart.
sources: Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0
Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1
Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void

title: Rakatan invasion strikes the Tython system
summary: The Force Hound Xesh, scouting for his Rakatan masters, finds a route to Tython. Predor Skal'nas follows with a fleet in search of a fabled Infinity Gate and seizes moons and worlds, until the Je'daii and the Settled Worlds join forces and repel him.
sources: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2
Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1

title: Force Wars end and the Jedi Order forms
summary: After ten years of war on Tython between Je'daii who follow the Ashla and those who embrace the Bogan, the light-side faction prevails and reorganizes as the Jedi Order. A catastrophe then wrecks Tython's biosphere, and the survivors resettle on Ossus.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia
The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)

title: Plague and revolt topple the Infinite Empire
summary: Already torn by civil war, the Rakata are struck by a plague that kills most of them and severs the survivors from the Force, crippling their Force-powered machines. Slave peoples rise everywhere and the Infinite Empire disintegrates, clearing the way for new powers.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

title: Xim the Despot builds a Tionese empire
summary: Inheriting the pirate kingdom of his father Xer VIII, the young warlord Xim pushes beyond the Tion Cluster with war-robots, mass terror and the GenoHaradan, a dreaded secret police. He takes the Thanium Worlds and the Kiirium Reaches before turning on the Hutts.
sources: Han Solo and the Lost Legacy

title: Hutts crush Xim at Vontor
summary: After two earlier clashes at Vontor, Kossak's Hutts bind the Klatooinians, Nikto and Vodrans to perpetual service in the Treaty of Vontor and throw them at Xim's army. The despot is taken prisoner and his empire breaks apart.
conflict: Hutt accounts have Xim die a blinded slave in Kossak's dungeons on Varl; Tionese histories insist he was treacherously slain at Vontor itself.

title: Galactic Constitution founds the Republic
summary: With hyperdrives copied from Rakatan designs, the Core Worlds reach outward and bind themselves together under the Galactic Constitution. The new Galactic Republic makes Coruscant its capital, with a Senate and a Supreme Chancellor at its head.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia
conflict: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia fixes the founding at 25,053 BBY; older works such as the Dark Empire Sourcebook simply call the Republic about 25,000 years old.

title: Perlemian Trade Route and Corellian Run charted
summary: Two great hyperlanes open the young Republic's frontier. The Perlemian runs from Coruscant to Ossus and on to the Tion Cluster, while the Corellian Run hands Corellia a trading lead; the wedge of space between them becomes known as the Slice.

title: Jedi of Ossus pledge to serve the Republic
summary: Republic scouts reach Ossus, where the Jedi have lived apart since leaving Tython. Master Haune Tiar travels back with them to Coruscant, and after weeks of talks the Order agrees to put its Knights at the young Republic's service.
conflict: The Old Republic's codex has the Jedi pledge themselves soon after first contact; The Essential Guide to Warfare keeps the Order aloof until the Tionese War, entering Republic service only around 23,900 BBY.

title: First Great Schism: Xendor's Legions of Lettow
summary: Refused permission to teach forbidden Force arts, the Jedi Xendor breaks away and raises the Legions of Lettow. War follows; Xendor dies at Columus, and Arden Lyn, who loved him, fatally wounds Master Awdrysta Pina, who stops her heart as he dies.

title: Tionese War tests the young Republic
summary: A Tionese alliance led from Desevro storms down the Perlemian and bombs Republic worlds. After a century of offensives the Republic wins and sterilizes Desevro; the atrocity briefly drives the Jedi away before they agree to stand watch over the Republic.

title: Jedi scout discovers the crystal world Ilum
summary: Drawn by the Force deep into the Unknown Regions, a lone Jedi scout finds the frozen planet Ilum and its caves of crystals. Ilum becomes a sacred site for the Order and a lasting source of the crystals at the heart of lightsabers.

title: Great Manifest Period of Republic expansion
summary: The Republic surges into the Slice and settles what becomes the Expansion Region. The Metellos Trade Route opens new commerce, sectors swell far beyond their legal limits, and a growing bureaucracy eventually spawns BoSS, the agency that regulates starship travel.

title: First Alsakan Conflict opens a long rivalry
summary: Alsakan and its Axis allies block Coruscant-backed trading companies from expanding south, starting the first Alsakan Conflict. BoSS, the Republic's shipping bureau, imposes a truce by threatening to switch off hyperspace beacons, but the rivalry flares again and again for fourteen millennia.

title: Star Dragons attack Coruscant
summary: Near Murkhana, Republic scouts flee their first sight of the Duinuogwuin, the Star Dragons, and hundreds of them give chase to Coruscant. Chancellor Fillorean learns they are sentient and makes peace with their thinker Borz'Mat'oh; the two then set up the University of Coruscant.

title: Hutt Cataclysms leave Varl a wasteland
summary: A Hutt civil war of unknown cause ends with Varl and the old Hutt colonies reduced to lifeless ruins. The surviving clans move to Evocar, the world later called Nal Hutta, and adopt the kajidic system under a Council of Elders.

title: Pius Dea sect seizes the chancellery
summary: The human-supremacist Pius Dea engineers Chancellor Pers'lya's impeachment and installs Contispex I. His dynasty rules for a thousand years, launching crusade after crusade against aliens, beginning with Hutt Space; in protest the Jedi withdraw to Ossus, a break called the Recusal.

title: Battle of Uquine ends Pius Dea rule
summary: Renunciates who have abandoned the Pius Dea faith join the Jedi, the Caamasi and Alsakan against the crusader regime. Its last fleet is annihilated at Uquine, Contispex XIX is captured and tried on Caamas, and Biel Ductavis, the Jedi Order's Grand Master, becomes Supreme Chancellor.

title: Waymancy Storm gives the Republic turbolasers
summary: A disastrous first contact with the technologically superior Signatories of Waymancy sets off a costly war on the Republic's northern frontier. The Republic prevails, copies the power generators of Waymancy's Machinesmith sisterhood and builds far stronger turbolasers.

title: Second Great Schism splits the Jedi
summary: Jedi experimenting with forbidden dark-side alchemy, warping living creatures into monsters, are condemned by the High Council and break away from the Order as Dark Jedi. Three years later the quarrel explodes into open war.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

title: The Hundred-Year Darkness
summary: Dark Jedi led by the likes of Ajunta Pall, XoXaan and Karness Muur loose alchemically bred armies on the Jedi and the Republic. A hundred years later the Jedi win at Corbos, and the surviving Dark Jedi are banished from Republic space.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side
conflict: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0 ties the banished Dark Jedi to the First Great Schism, and Secrets of the Sith puts their century-long war anywhere from 25,000 to 5,000 BBY; The New Essential Chronology fixes it at c. 7000–6900 BBY.

title: Mandalore the First claims a new homeworld
summary: The Taung warlord Mandalore the First takes his people from Roon to conquer a wild world, slaughtering its giant mythosaurs. His followers name the planet Mandalore after him and begin calling themselves Mandalorians.

title: Exiled Dark Jedi become lords of the Sith
summary: Banished after Corbos, the Dark Jedi Exiles land on Korriban and overpower the Force-sensitive Sith species, who come to revere them. Rulers and natives intermarry into a sorcerous Sith Empire, and Ajunta Pall takes the throne as their first Dark Lord.
sources: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side
conflict: The Ultimate Visual Guide still has the Exiles falling "in the early years of the Old Republic", long before the c. 6900 BBY exile given in The New Essential Chronology, whose date later works follow.

title: Tenebrae becomes Lord Vitiate of Nathema
summary: Three years after murdering his father, Lord Dramath, to take his world, the young Tenebrae is rewarded by Dark Lord Marka Ragnos with rule of the planet, renamed Nathema, and the title Lord Vitiate.

title: Marka Ragnos dies; Sadow and Kressh clash
summary: The death of Dark Lord Marka Ragnos closes the Sith golden age. At his funeral on Korriban, Naga Sadow duels Ludo Kressh over the succession until Ragnos's spirit halts them; Sadow later outwits Kressh and takes command of the Empire.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith

title: The Great Hyperspace War
summary: When explorers Gav and Jori Daragon blunder into Sith space, Naga Sadow follows their route to invade the Republic, striking Coruscant and the Koros worlds. His armies prove partly illusion; beaten and chased home, he flees to a hidden refuge on Yavin 4.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire
Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith

title: The Omen strands the Lost Tribe on Kesh
summary: Knocked off course during the war, Sadow's warship Omen crash-lands on Kesh, a remote world. Its crew, under Captain Yaru Korsin, are hailed as gods by the native Keshiri and build a Sith society, the Lost Tribe, cut off from the galaxy for millennia.
sources: Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice

title: Ritual of Nathema makes Vitiate immortal
summary: Summoning some eight thousand Sith Lords to Nathema, Vitiate binds their minds to his and works a vast rite that kills everything alive on the planet and leaves it void of the Force. He emerges immortal, the Sith Emperor.

title: Sith Emperor rebuilds his empire on Dromund Kaas
summary: Blaming the Jedi for Nathema, the Emperor leads the old Empire's survivors on a twenty-year exodus into the Unknown Regions. On the storm-wracked jungle world Dromund Kaas he founds a reborn Sith Empire that quietly prepares its revenge.

title: Freedon Nadd falls and rules Onderon
summary: Refused knighthood, the Jedi Freedon Nadd finds Naga Sadow's spirit on Yavin 4, learns Sith sorcery, then destroys his teacher. He crowns himself king of Onderon, where banishing criminals beyond the walls of Iziz sets off the centuries-long Beast Wars.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

title: Vultar Cataclysm destroys an entire star system
summary: Dark Jedi, driven off Coruscant by the Third Great Schism, flee to the Vultar system and try to master the Celestials' Cosmic Turbine. They cannot control it, and the machine obliterates the whole system, leaving only a nebula.

title: Bacta reaches the wider galaxy
summary: The insectoid Vratix of Thyferra share bacta, their regenerative healing fluid, with the rest of the galaxy. It rivals the older kolto, and because it can be mass-produced only on Thyferra, control of that world becomes a lasting prize.

title: Jedi rout the Lorell Raiders, birthing Hapes
summary: Jedi Master Arca Jeth and his Knights shatter the Lorell Raiders, a pirate band that has preyed on Perlemian shipping for generations. The survivors retreat into the Hapes Cluster, where the women they had captured eventually build the matriarchal, isolationist Hapes Consortium.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Alien Species

title: HK-01 leads the Great Droid Revolution
summary: HK-01, an assassin droid built by Czerka, rewrites the code of thousands of droids on Coruscant and sets them against their owners. Jedi and Republic rocket-jumpers end the revolt after three months, and Arca Jeth learns to short out droids with the Force.
conflict: The Essential Guide to Warfare dates the revolt to 4015 BBY; the Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide sets it in the years of the Great Sith War instead.

title: Arca Jeth's apprentices end Onderon's Beast Wars
summary: Arca Jeth sends Ulic Qel-Droma, his brother Cay and Tott Doneeta to settle Onderon's feud. Princess Galia loves the Beast Rider chief Oron Kira, and her royal house serves the dark side; Jeth's battle meditation carries the fight for Iziz, and Queen Amanoa dies.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon

title: Freedon Nadd Uprising on Onderon
summary: King Ommin's dark-side Naddists rise against the Jedi and Onderon's Beast Riders, seize Arca Jeth and steal the bodies of Nadd and the late queen. Republic troops and more Jedi beat him, but the visiting Keto cousins, Aleema and Satal, escape with Sith lore.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising

title: Keto cousins seize Empress Teta for the Krath
summary: Aleema and Satal Keto overthrow their own parents and take the Empress Teta system for themselves, ruling through the Krath, a Sith cult. Their sorcery routs a Republic fleet at Koros Major, and Krath war droids kill Arca Jeth at the Jedi conclave on Deneba.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith

title: Kun and Qel-Droma are crowned Sith Lords
summary: Ulic Qel-Droma, infiltrating the Krath, is seduced by Aleema and kills Satal. Exar Kun, a fallen Jedi taught by Freedon Nadd's spirit, comes to duel him, but Marka Ragnos's ghost proclaims both men Sith Lords, master and apprentice; they found the Sith Brotherhood.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith

title: Ulic defeats Mandalore the Indomitable on Kuar
summary: Ulic Qel-Droma fights Mandalore the Indomitable man to man on Kuar's Plains of Harkul and wins. The Mandalorian Crusaders swear themselves to his Sith cause and join the coming war.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War

title: The Great Sith War
summary: Kun's Brotherhood, the Krath and Mandalorian Crusaders strike across the galaxy, from Deep Core worlds to the Rim. Ulic is captured raiding Coruscant, where Kun murders Master Vodo-Siosk Baas; freed, Ulic kills his brother Cay, and Nomi Sunrider severs him from the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War
conflict: The Dark Empire endnotes describe this war with no Exar Kun or Sith, the Krath splitting into three rival factions, whereas Tales of the Jedi, published later, tells it very differently.

title: Cron Supernova devastates Ossus
summary: At Kemplex Nine, Aleema Keto's Sith sorcery unwittingly sets off a chain of stellar explosions in the Cron Cluster, killing her. The blast wave scorches Ossus; the Jedi evacuate their ancient library world and later make Coruscant their home.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War

title: Exar Kun falls on Yavin 4
summary: Guided by the repentant Ulic, Jedi and a Republic fleet converge on Yavin 4. Kun drains the Massassi to free his spirit; the Jedi's united will meets his ritual in a firestorm that scorches the moon and traps his ghost in its temples.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War

title: Revan is born
note: Wookieepedia's estimate: Revan is about forty when The Old Republic: Revan opens, and The Essential Reader's Companion sets that opening in 3954 BBY.
summary: The future Revan is born, probably on an Outer Rim world. Raised by the Jedi, the child grows into a charismatic Knight whose defiance of the Council will shape the next half-century of galactic history.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

title: Ulic Qel-Droma dies on Rhen Var
summary: In exile on icy Rhen Var, Ulic has begun teaching Nomi's daughter Vima. The Cathar Jedi Sylvar comes for revenge, but he will not fight and her rage breaks; moments later the spacer Hoggon shoots him dead for glory.
sources: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption

title: The Mandalorian Wars
summary: Mandalore the Ultimate's Neo-Crusaders raid and conquer worlds beyond the Republic's edge for more than a decade before crashing into Republic space. Taris is besieged and three invasion corridors open before Revan's Jedi turn the tide.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)
conflict: Knights of the Old Republic itself gives two starting years, 3976 BBY by Mandalorian reckoning and 3963 BBY by the Republic's; the Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide counts the main war from 3965 BBY.

title: Neo-Crusaders nearly exterminate the Cathar
summary: Under Cassus Fett, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders fall on the feline Cathar in their home system, killing more than nine in ten of them and enslaving many survivors. Proof of the massacre later spurs Revan's Jedi into the war.
sources: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)

title: Padawan Massacre on Taris
summary: Fearing a prophecy that one of their students will bring ruin, five Masters of the secretive Jedi Covenant murder their own Padawans on Taris. Zayne Carrick, late to the ceremony, survives, is framed for the killings and flees with the con artist Marn Hierogryph.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)

title: Revan leads Jedi into the Mandalorian Wars
summary: Defying the Council's caution, the charismatic Jedi called the Revanchist gathers like-minded Knights and uncovers proof of the Cathar massacre. The Council grudgingly lets them fight; he takes the name Revan, with his friend Malak at his side.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)
Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

title: Battle of Malachor V ends the Mandalorian Wars
summary: Supreme Commander Revan draws the Mandalorian fleet to Malachor V and kills Mandalore the Ultimate. At General Meetra Surik's command the Mass Shadow Generator fires, crushing both fleets, shattering the planet and leaving a lasting wound in the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords
Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
conflict: The Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide dates the battle to 3960 BBY, while The Ultimate Visual Guide has the war's final year as 3961 BBY; the games and later articles also disagree on how the battle unfolded.

title: Revan and Malak return as Sith Lords
summary: After years lost in the Unknown Regions, war heroes Revan and Malak return leading a Sith armada, seize Korriban and harness the Rakatan Star Forge to build endless warships. Many veterans follow them, and their invasion of the Republic opens the Jedi Civil War.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
conflict: In Knights of the Old Republic the Jedi blame the pair's fall on their exploration of Dantooine's ancient ruins, while Vrook suspects it started before the Mandalorian Wars; The Old Republic: Revan adds that the Sith Emperor broke both men in the Unknown Regions.

title: Sith bombers devastate Telos IV
summary: Admiral Saul Karath, now serving the Sith, hands over Republic codes, and Malak's bombers hit Telos IV without warning. Millions die, Carth Onasi's wife Morgana among them, and the planet's poisoned surface needs years of restoration.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
conflict: Carth's lines in Knights of the Old Republic put the attack in 3960 BBY, before the war; the Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide moves it to 3958 BBY, and Wookieepedia's timeline lists it under 3959 BBY.

title: Malak betrays Revan; the Jedi capture him
summary: As Bastila Shan's strike team boards Revan's flagship, Malak fires on it with his own fleet and makes himself Dark Lord. The Jedi carry the gravely wounded Revan away, erase his memory and give him a new identity.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

title: Malak's fleet destroys Taris
summary: Hunting Bastila Shan, Malak blockades Taris. When she escapes aboard the Ebon Hawk with Carth Onasi and the amnesiac Revan, his fleet bombards the city-planet into ruin, killing billions.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

title: Star Forge destroyed at Rakata Prime
summary: Following the Star Maps to Lehon, the redeemed Revan leads the Republic fleet against Malak's armada. He wins back Bastila Shan, defeats Malak blade to blade and wrecks the Star Forge, bringing the Jedi Civil War to a close.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

title: Sith Triumvirate begins the First Jedi Purge
summary: From Malachor V, the Sith Triumvirate of Traya, Sion and Nihilus gathers what is left of Malak's empire. Sion's assassins hunt Jedi everywhere, the Order goes into hiding, and within a few years almost no Jedi remain in the known galaxy.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords
Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

title: Darth Nihilus consumes Katarr
summary: The last hundred or so Jedi meet in secret on the Miraluka world Katarr, where Atris hopes to lure out their hidden enemy. Darth Nihilus comes and devours every living being there; only the young Visas Marr survives.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

title: Canderous Ordo becomes Mandalore the Preserver
summary: Taking up the mask of Mandalore, Canderous Ordo rallies the scattered clans at a camp on Onderon's moon Dxun and sets about restoring their strength. His warriors fight beside the Exile against the Sith.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

title: The Exile destroys the Sith Triumvirate
summary: Meetra Surik, the Jedi Exile, regains the Force and hunts the Triumvirate. She kills Darth Nihilus above Telos IV, then defeats Darth Sion and her own mentor Kreia, Darth Traya, as Malachor V is destroyed, ending the Purge and the Old Sith Wars.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

title: Revan and the Exile confront the Sith Emperor
summary: Revan and Meetra Surik infiltrate the Emperor's citadel on Dromund Kaas, aided by the Sith Lord Scourge. Scourge betrays them, stabbing Surik from behind, and the Emperor overpowers Revan and holds him captive for some three centuries.

title: Grizmallt colonists settle Naboo
summary: Grizmallt's Queen Elsinoré den Tasia sends out three colony ships that vanish from contact, then turn up on Naboo. Their human settlers take the plains and hills, living uneasily beside the native Gungans, and become the people later called the Naboo.

title: Freia Kallea blazes the Hydian Way
summary: The Brentaal explorer Freia Kallea stitches existing routes into one hyperlane running from the galaxy's north to its southern rim, surviving six years stranded on Nuvar along the way. Christened in 3693 BBY, the Hydian Way becomes a great trade artery.
conflict: Older works, Imperial Double-Cross among them, put Kallea's voyage near 3000 BBY; The Essential Atlas moved it earlier, ahead of the setting of The Old Republic.

title: The Great Galactic War
summary: Emerging from the Unknown Regions, the Emperor's Sith Empire destroys a Republic convoy in the Tingel Arm, then retakes Korriban. Twenty-eight years of war follow, from a Sith blockade of the Rimma route to battles at Bothawui, Alderaan and Hoth.
sources: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)
Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace

title: Coruscant sacked; Treaty of Coruscant signed
summary: While Republic envoys discuss peace on Alderaan, Darth Malgus storms Coruscant, wrecking the Jedi Temple and killing Chancellor Berooken and Grand Master Zym. With its capital held hostage, the Republic signs the Treaty of Coruscant, ceding worlds for an uneasy Cold War.
sources: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant

title: Satele Shan leads the Jedi back to Tython
summary: With their Coruscant temple in ruins, the Jedi follow Satele Shan to Tython, the long-forbidden cradle of their Order, which she has rediscovered. They resettle it and raise a new temple, finished by 3647 BBY; Shan later becomes Grand Master.
sources: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)

title: Cold War collapses into open Galactic War
summary: Years of proxy fights, from Ord Mantell's separatist war to Alderaan's civil war and Darth Angral's private vendetta, finally wreck the Treaty of Coruscant. Republic and Empire return to open war across the galaxy.
conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline dates the outbreak to 3642 BBY; its Cold War and Galactic War articles, following The Old Republic's own dating, give 3641 BBY.

title: Hero of Tython strikes down the Sith Emperor
summary: While Satele Shan's fleet engages the Imperial home guard, a Jedi strike team under the Hero of Tython confronts the Emperor in his Dromund Kaas stronghold and halts a ritual meant to feed on all the galaxy's life. His body seems destroyed, but he survives.

title: Revan's last stand on Yavin 4
summary: Escaped at last from the Emperor's prison, Revan gathers followers into the Order of Revan, scheming to revive Vitiate so he can destroy him for good. A joint Republic and Imperial coalition defeats him on Yavin 4, and Revan's spirit finally passes on.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan

title: Vitiate devours all life on Ziost
summary: Revived by Revan's scheme, Vitiate seizes the minds of Ziost's people and sets Imperial and Republic troops against each other there. He then kills everything alive on the ancient Sith world and vanishes, leaving a gray, dead planet.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan
conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline places this in 3637 BBY; its Ziost and Invasion of Ziost articles give 3636 BBY, following The Old Republic's update dating.

title: Zakuul's Eternal Empire conquers the known galaxy
summary: From Wild Space, Zakuul's Eternal Fleet sweeps into the Core and overwhelms Republic and Empire alike, forcing each to pay tribute. Its new ruler Arcann, whose father Valkorion is secretly Vitiate, freezes the Outlander in carbonite.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire

title: The Alliance ends Vitiate for good
summary: Thawed from carbonite, the Outlander builds the Eternal Alliance on Odessen and takes the war to Zakuul. The Alliance topples Empress Vaylin and at last destroys Vitiate's spirit, ending the Sith who had bent the galaxy to his will for nearly fifteen centuries.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire
Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne

title: Darth Ruin's schism opens the New Sith Wars
summary: Jedi Master Phanius quits the Order, taking fifty followers with him, and renames himself Darth Ruin, creating the New Sith. This Fourth Great Schism starts a thousand-year struggle between Jedi and Sith that bleeds the Republic white.
sources: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side
conflict: The Phantom Menace novelization credits this rogue Jedi with founding the Sith itself "almost two thousand years ago", which contradicts Tales of the Jedi; in 2000 The Essential Chronology recast him as founder of a successor order, the New Sith.

title: Republic army routed at Mizra
summary: A Sith sniper kills the Jedi coordinator whose battle meditation is holding a huge Republic army together. The force collapses into a rout: over half a million soldiers die, hundreds of Jedi are captured, and the Republic nears defeat.
sources: The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)

title: Belia Darzu's technobeasts: the Sictis Wars
summary: The shape-shifting Dark Lord Belia Darzu uses the Sith art of mechu-deru to turn victims into mechanical technobeasts, breeding an army in her fortress on Tython. Twenty years later the Mecrosa Order and her own followers assassinate her.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Droids

title: The Republic Dark Age
summary: Through the last century of Jedi-Sith warfare, the Republic fragments so badly that later historians count it as dissolved. Sith empires and Jedi Lords with private armies carve up the galaxy while Coruscant's government shrinks to a shadow.

title: Mandalore the Uniter rebuilds Mandalorian Space
summary: Coming home to find his clan nearly wiped out by the Candorian plague, the mercenary Aga Awaud rallies Mandalorians against raiders. Hailed as Mandalore the Uniter in 1051 BBY, he turns Mandalorian Space into a strong regional power in industry and war.

title: Dessel, the future Darth Bane, is born
note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: The Essential Reader's Companion starts Path of Destruction in 1003 BBY, and the novel fixes Dessel's age at his father's death five years earlier.
summary: Dessel is born on Apatros, a bleak cortosis-mining world in the Outer Rim. Brutalized by his miner father, he grows up strong and bitter, unaware that his rage is feeding on the Force's dark side.

title: Kaan's Brotherhood faces Hoth's Army of Light
summary: Jedi Master Skere Kaan defects with like-minded Jedi and forges the Brotherhood of Darkness, a Sith order whose Lords claim to be equals. In answer, Lord Hoth unites the Jedi baronies into the Army of Light to carry the war to the Sith.

title: The Ruusan campaign begins
summary: Hoth's Army of Light meets Kaan's Brotherhood of Darkness on Ruusan, beginning two years of ground and orbital fighting. Seven major battles scar the planet as both sides pour their strength into the decisive front.

title: Dessel takes the name Darth Bane
note: Not on Wookieepedia's timeline; its Darth Bane article gives 1001–1000 BBY for his years as a Brotherhood Dark Lord and dates the duel on Lehon to 1000 BBY.
summary: Trained at the reopened Sith academy on Korriban, Dessel outgrows his masters, renames himself Darth Bane and rejects Kaan's rule of equals. On Lehon he studies Darth Revan's holocron and resolves that the Sith should number just two, master and apprentice.

title: Thought bomb ends the Battle of Ruusan
summary: Goaded by Darth Bane, the cornered Lord Kaan unleashes the thought bomb in Ruusan's caves. It annihilates Kaan's Sith Lords along with Lord Hoth and ninety-nine Jedi. Bane, who stayed away, survives and takes the young Zannah as his apprentice, ending the New Sith Wars.
